QUESTIONS PEOPLE ASK BEFORE HIRING US FOR LINKEDIN ADS
Answers written and reviewed by Khalid Farhan, founder. Last reviewed November 2026.
Is LinkedIn Ads worth it for my business?

LinkedIn works best for B2B businesses targeting decision-makers with higher-value products or services. If your customer is a C-suite, VP, manager, or specific job function, LinkedIn's targeting is unmatched.
What budget do I need?

LinkedIn has a minimum daily budget of €10/day. We recommend €2,000+/month to generate enough data for proper optimisation. CPCs are higher than Google or Meta but lead quality is typically significantly higher for B2B.
Can you target specific companies?
Yes. LinkedIn's Matched Audiences feature lets us upload company lists and target named accounts — perfect for ABM programmes.
